definitions.gloss: monthly salary system; salaried payment system
definitions.explanation: A wage system in which an employee receives a fixed sum each month, as opposed to hourly or daily wages. The standard arrangement for full-time {正社員|せいしゃいん} in Japan.

examples.japanese: うちの{会社|かいしゃ}は{月給制|げっきゅうせい}だ。
examples.english: Our company uses a monthly salary system.

examples.japanese: {月給制|げっきゅうせい}と{時給制|じきゅうせい}のどちらがいいですか。
examples.english: Which is better, a monthly salary system or an hourly wage system?

examples.japanese: {転職|てんしょく}して{時給制|じきゅうせい}から{月給制|げっきゅうせい}に{変|か}わった。
examples.english: I changed jobs and went from an hourly wage to a monthly salary system.

notes:
Compound of {月給|げっきゅう} (monthly salary) + {制|せい} (system).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {月給制|げっきゅうせい}を{採用|さいよう}する: to adopt a monthly salary system
- {月給制|げっきゅうせい}で{働|はたら}く: to work on a monthly salary basis

RELATED WORDS:
- {年俸制|ねんぽうせい}: annual salary system — payment negotiated and paid as an annual total
- {時給制|じきゅうせい}: hourly wage system — common for part-time work
- {日給制|にっきゅうせい}: daily wage system — common for construction and day labor
